from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's cash balance data extracted from its financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing the report")
    cash_line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific balance sheet label used (e.g., 'Cash', 'Cash and Cash Equivalents')")
    reported_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash balance as written in the document")
    amount_unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale unit of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    reporting_period_end: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_records: list[CompanyCashRecord]
